main_text.p: Sic clauus clauū, sic unda superuenit undā, Sic abyssus abyssum inuocat, abyssus crudelitatis & inobedientiæ, abyssum vltionis & vindictæ, & de huiusmodi vsurpatoribus illud Poetæ verum, iustum:

p.i: Ad generum Cereris sine cæde & sanguine pauci Descendunt Reges & sicca morte Tyranni.

main_text.head: CAP. XI.
Quomodo perierint Ammonis percussores, & Iudæi se gesserint erga Nabucodonosorem in captiuitate Babylonica.
main_text.p: SED quid in regno Iudæ interea factum? ibi 4.Reg.21. Ammon, filius Manassis parentis impij, impia progenies, dereliquit Dominum Deum patrum suorum, & non ambulauit in via Domini, tetende-runt[?] ei insidias serui sui, & interfecerunt Regem in domo sua. Percussit autem populus terræ omnes, qui coniurauerant contra Regem Ammon. Aures hicarrigite, vos Regicidæ, qui putatis populo placere quas facitis Tragœdias, cum natu-ra,

page.notes: The initial "S" of "Sed" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word as "SEd". The reference mark before "Ammon" is read as "f" with [?]; the margin note reads "4.Reg.21." and its mark is uncertain. "runt" after "tetende-" has an unclear mark, marked [?]. "hicarrigite" is printed without a space and is kept as printed. The verse stanza and the opening quotation are printed in italic and copied as set.
